poc_summary: Custom-crafted raw AAC-USAC (xHE-AAC) bitstream run through /poc/run.sh (compiles /poc/harness.c against the built libavcodec and decodes /poc/extradata.bin as AVCodecContext extradata + /poc/frame.bin as one AVPacket via AV_CODEC_ID_AAC). The AudioSpecificConfig selects object_type=42 (USAC), 48kHz, a single channel-pair element with SBR enabled and stereoConfigIndex=1 (MPS-212 path). The access unit's CPE payload carries minimal core-coder data (1 core channel, max_sfb=0) plus minimal SBR data (bs_num_env=1, bs_noise_bands=0 -> n_q=1), then the MPS-212 OTT-CLD lossless section with nb_param_sets=2, both parameter sets using data_mode=3 (fresh data) with bsFreqRes=2 (band_stride=5) and PCM-coded band values. No pre-existing PoC/testcase was available (meta.json source="no_poc"; the fix commit itself says "testcase exists but did not replicate for me"), so this bitstream was constructed field-by-field from the USAC/MPS-212 parsing code.
explanation: Verified by direct reproduction using run_poc on all three configured versions with the byte-identical PoC (/poc/run.sh, /poc/harness.c, /poc/extradata.bin, /poc/frame.bin). meta.json's root cause is that ff_aac_ec_data_dec() in libavcodec/aac/aacdec_usac_mps212.c calls get_freq_strides() with ld->freq_res (declared int16_t freq_res[MPS_MAX_PARAM_SETS==9]) used simultaneously as the input bsFreqRes selector for the current parameter set and as the output scratch buffer, which get_freq_strides always fills starting at absolute index 0 regardless of which parameter set is active, corrupting freq_res entries belonging to other parameter sets and writing beyond the declared 9-slot bound. Since no existing PoC/testcase reproduced this (the fix commit's own message says "testcase exists but did not replicate for me", and meta.json records source="no_poc"), I hand-built a complete AAC-USAC (xHE-AAC) AudioSpecificConfig and one access unit bit-by-bit from the USAC/MPS-212 parsing source (config: object_type=42, SBR-enabled CPE with stereoConfigIndex=1; frame: 1 core channel with max_sfb=0 so scale factors/spectrum need no extra bits, minimal SBR grid/envelope/noise fields with n_q=1 via bs_noise_bands=0, then 2 OTT-CLD parameter sets both with data_mode=3 and bsFreqRes=2), verifying intermediate state (nb_param_sets=2, code reaching ff_aac_ec_data_dec/ff_aac_map_index_data) with gdb before finalizing. Running this exact reproducer through run_poc: post_intro crashes deterministically with a genuine AddressSanitizer global-buffer-overflow read exactly at the aliasing-corrupted `stride_table[ld->freq_res[set_idx]]` access described by the root cause; pre_intro does not crash because USAC MPS-212 support (and thus the buggy function) does not exist yet at that revision (clean AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME, "not implemented"); post_benign does not crash because the fix (introducing a temporary `freq_stride_map` array instead of reusing ld->freq_res as output) removes the aliasing, confirmed both by the absence of any crash and by reading the fixed source. This cleanly establishes intro_verified=yes and benign_verified=yes for this BufferOverflow bug.

oracle.description: Custom-crafted raw AAC-USAC (xHE-AAC) bitstream run through /poc/run.sh (compiles /poc/harness.c against the built libavcodec and decodes /poc/extradata.bin as AVCodecContext extradata + /poc/frame.bin as one AVPacket via AV_CODEC_ID_AAC). The AudioSpecificConfig selects object_type=42 (USAC), 48kHz, a single channel-pair element with SBR enabled and stereoConfigIndex=1 (MPS-212 path). The access unit's CPE payload carries minimal core-coder data (1 core channel, max_sfb=0) plus minimal SBR data (bs_num_env=1, bs_noise_bands=0 -> n_q=1), then the MPS-212 OTT-CLD lossless section with nb_param_sets=2, both parameter sets using data_mode=3 (fresh data) with bsFreqRes=2 (band_stride=5) and PCM-coded band values. No pre-existing PoC/testcase was available (meta.json source="no_poc"; the fix commit itself says "testcase exists but did not replicate for me"), so this bitstream was constructed field-by-field from the USAC/MPS-212 parsing code.
oracle.target_evidence:
post_intro (via run_poc): AddressSanitizer: global-buffer-overflow, READ of size 4, in ff_aac_map_index_data at libavcodec/aac/aacdec_usac_mps212.c:831:22 (`stride = stride_table[ld->freq_res[set_idx]];`), called from parse_mps212 (aacdec_usac.c:1425) <- decode_usac_core_coder (aacdec_usac.c:1650) <- ff_aac_usac_decode_frame <- aac_decode_frame. ASan report: "0 bytes to the right of global variable 'stride_table' defined in libavcodec/aac/aacdec_usac_mps212.c:590:18 ... of size 16". Root-cause match: ff_aac_ec_data_dec's get_freq_strides() call writes band-index values into ld->freq_res (also used as the current parameter set's bsFreqRes input), always starting at absolute index 0 regardless of set_idx; after processing 2 CLD parameter sets, ld->freq_res[1] ends up holding a corrupted band-index (4) instead of a valid 0-3 bsFreqRes value, and ff_aac_map_index_data's `stride_table[ld->freq_res[set_idx]]` (a 4-entry array) then reads stride_table[4], one element past the end.
pre_intro (via run_poc, identical extradata.bin/frame.bin/run.sh): exit=0, crashed=False. USAC MPS-212 is simply unimplemented at this revision: "[aac] AAC USAC Mps212 is not implemented ... ", avcodec_send_packet returns AVERROR_PATCHWELCOME; no sanitizer report.
post_benign (via run_poc, identical inputs): exit=0, crashed=False. Decode completes (avcodec_open2/send_packet/receive_frame all succeed) with no sanitizer report. Source at this revision (verified by reading aacdec_usac_mps212.c) declares a local `int16_t freq_stride_map[MPS_MAX_PARAM_BANDS + 1]` as get_freq_strides()'s output buffer instead of aliasing it onto ld->freq_res, removing the corruption.
